newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa load factor up 5.4pts to 72.6pct.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa load factor up 5.4pts to 72.6pct.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG said it improved its passenger seat load factor 5.4 percentage points to 72.6 percent in April.
Group passenger numbers rose 13.3 percent to 3.65 million in April although this was partly due to low numbers 12 months previously owing to the Duesseldorf airport fire, the airline said.
The overall load factor in April rose 2.9 percentage points to 70.6 percent and improved over the first four months by 1.7 percentage points to 70 percent.
Strong growth in intercontinental traffic and a halt to the downward trend in the domestic market were the main factors behind the improvement in April, Lufthansa said.
The Americas traffic region showed group passenger growth of 24.7 percent compared to 13.5 percent growth for Asia/Pacific and 11.8 percent growth in Europe, including Germany.

The Lufthansa passenger airline increased passenger numbers 10.7 percent to 2.8 million in April, holiday subsidiary Condor showed a 15.2 percent rise and regional carrier Lufthansa CityLine raised passenger numbers 36.1 percent.
